result.evidence_quote: This study aimed to quantify exercise-induced GI symptoms, gut fullness, blood glucose response, and ratings of perceived exertion in response to low-protein (LP) and moderate-protein (MP) pre-exercise shake.
result.rationale: The study evaluates pre-exercise protein intake and gastrointestinal tolerance in runners. It does not examine cardiovascular disease, cardiovascular risk prediction or prevention, or therapies affecting cardiovascular outcomes.
